submit.title: Submit Request
submit.body: Fill in the form and submit your verification request.

review.title: Review
review.body: Our team will review your information (usually within 2–5 business days).

collection.title: Sample Collection
collection.body: We will coordinate the collection of honey samples, sealed by Kounouz.

analysis.title: Laboratory Analysis
analysis.body: Your samples will be analyzed in accredited labs.

verified.title: Get Verified
verified.body: You will receive a notification once your honey is verified.

notes.title: Important Notes
items: Ensure your documents are up to date
You will be notified at each step
Our team may contact you for additional details

wizard.importantBody: You do not need to create a Batch ID. The official Batch ID will be assigned by Kounouz Alafiya after the laboratory verification is completed.

tips.title: Tips for accurate information
items: Provide the most accurate dates and location.
Select the closest floral origin if known.
This information helps us ensure traceability and quality.

wizard.nextBody: After you submit this information, our team will review your request and contact you to arrange the sample collection.
wizard.batchIdNote: The official Batch ID will be created by Kounouz Alafiya after the verification process is completed.
wizard.controlBody: Sample sealing, laboratory results and the final decision are managed by Kounouz Alafiya only.
wizard.confirmStatement: I confirm that the information provided is accurate and I agree that Kounouz Alafiya collects and analyzes a sample of this honey.
wizard.draftSaved: Draft saved. You can come back and finish it at any time.
